fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-01-28 around 11:05 hrs, it was reported that a rented premises near Kalai Park Main Street was allegedly occupied by a person after the lease ended, and the keys were not returned. Sanjay Raj reported the matter orally at Thanjavur East PS; the contact number given was 9000000083. A witness, Praveen Balan, reachable on 9000000446, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Selvam Rajan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000157. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Premises allegedly occupied after the lease period ended.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, photograph, mobile number, witness, main street, suspect, morning
